products.name: Riso Carnaroli
pros: Large, round grains that absorb sauces well
Keeps al dente for a long time
Ideal for risotto and other dishes

products.name: Riso Basmati

trustedSourceSummary: Fresh official consumer updates were combined with the latest archived comparison pages from 2025-2026. Organizations used: Altroconsumo. Altroconsumo’s laboratory tests (November 2025) recommend Riso Carnaroli for its excellent cooking retention and Riso Basmati for its low stickiness and aromatic profile; the evidence is from over 60 days ago.
